edits.old: Then judge how much the represented and missing meaning each matter to the complete post. Consider how the rest of the post develops, supports, or depends on each. Representing the complete post’s topic alone may leave important meaning missing.
edits.new: Allocate a fixed total of 100 points across the complete post’s meaning according to how much each part matters to that post. Assess each part within the complete post, not as a standalone statement. Divide those points between meaning represented by the mask and meaning missing from it, without counting the same meaning twice. Prominence is the represented share; the missing share is exactly 100 minus prominence. Consider how the rest of the post develops, supports, or depends on each part. Representing the complete post’s topic alone may leave important meaning missing.
